title: Resolve and transport the AC1032 large-radial picture-block graph
scope: Resolve a DWG DIMENSION common handle to its canonical DXF group-2 picture-block name, preserve the selected source block graph through ASCII/Binary DXF output and typed readback, and refuse strict output when a non-null source pointer has no resolved name.

priorEvidence.role: Retains the already-verified center/chord/jog and common dimension-field comparisons; this slice adds source block-name resolution and picture-block graph output/readback.

source.repositoryStatus: Already tracked in libdxfrw; no fixture added or modified

authority.name: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1

sections.20.4.22: Common Dimension Data; common handle tail includes H code 2 for the anonymous BLOCK hard pointer.
sections.20.4.30: LARGE_RADIAL_DIMENSION; repeats the DIMSTYLE hard pointer and anonymous BLOCK hard pointer in Common Entity Handle Data.

authority.decision: Resolve the already-parsed source handle through the BLOCK_RECORD map. The matching BLOCK delimiter name is the canonical DXF group-2 representation; do not alter DWG byte parsing.

behavior: Before entity delivery, read valid BLOCK delimiter names and normalize their BLOCK_RECORD names, so dimension-to-block name resolution is independent of unordered block traversal order.
Populate the DIMENSION group-2 name from its parsed DWG blockH reference for aligned, linear, angular, radial, diametric, arc and large-radial dimension callbacks.
In strict DXF output, reject a non-null source picture-block handle whose group-2 name is unresolved, before writing the entity record.
implementation.selectedOutputReadback: The tracked large-radial record and its one matching picture-block definition/record are projected to ASCII and Binary DXF. Readback requires one typed dimension with the same group-2 name, one matching block, and the same ordered entity-type sequence in that block.

validation.strictUnresolvedHandleControl: The ASCII and Binary wave1 controls inject a non-null DWG picture-block handle with no group-2 name; strict write fails with unresolved-dimension-picture-block and leaves the preexisting output prefix unchanged.

limitations: This qualifies one tracked AC1032 large-radial source profile and typed field/block-entity-type transport only.
It does not verify exact geometry for each picture-block member or native CAD display/regeneration semantics.
Whole-document strict conversion, other dimension producers/versions, and general dimension support remain unqualified.

planImpact.completedSlice: The tracked AC1032 large-radial DWG hard pointer resolves to group-2 name *D1; its selected dimension and picture-block graph survive production ASCII/Binary output and typed readback. Strict output refuses a non-null handle without a resolved name.
planImpact.remaining: Native dimension display, whole-document conversion, other DIMENSION/annotation profiles, and remaining P6 semantic/version boundaries.
planImpact.nextReadyPacket: Continue the P6 residual audit on another source-backed annotation or geometry profile; do not change DWG field layouts without an ODA-backed producer trace.
